esde.label: ES-DE
esde.note: System folders use the ES-DE names.

knulli.label: Knulli
knulli.note: Card root is the SHARE partition (/userdata). Folder names are case-sensitive and use Batocera system names; Knulli only scans subfolders of roms/. Systems with knulli = null have no Knulli system.

onion.label: Onion
onion.note: Miyoo Mini family (SigmaStar SSD202D). Card root is the FAT32 SD card; Onion creates missing Roms/ folders on first install. Folder names are case sensitive, differ from the stock Miyoo card, and are not ES-DE or Batocera names. Subfolders work only one level deep (e.g. Roms/GB/Hacks). BIOS files go in the root BIOS/ folder unless a system says otherwise. Systems with onion = null have no verified Onion folder. Source: https://onionui.github.io/docs/emulators/folders
